answer: The issuer re-attests the record each epoch, and any gap in the history voids the identity. Each of 260 aliases needs its own registry entries, and the years behind each one make bulk forgery cost more than the reward. Honesty stays cheap and fakery is priced per head: the whisper signal is public, the onyx check is automatic, and 260 aliases cost 260 times what one real agent costs, with the tide trail open to all.
